reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi Great Mosque campus:three mapped expanded/old wings,open-sky white Mataf court with the individually oriented black-and-gold Kaaba,Hatim and Maqam Ibrahim;long Sai gallery,stepped pale marble roofs,small roof domes,arcaded facades and thirteen mapped minaret groups. Shared materials and four authored browser levels. Current raw map controls retained;construction state,fine profiles and exact terrain joins remain approximate or unverified.
